notes.title: Big Update & Now On Mobile
notes.content:
Hey fruit fans! A big content update for Fruit Stand Fortune is here! We have tons of new features available for free! Also Fruit Stand Fortune is now available on the Google Play store! This game was made for mobile from the start, so consider checking out the app if you want the definitive way to play! 


🍉Whats new?🍉
🍒 10 new customers - some with special abilities requested by users!

🍋 6 new fruit with special effects

🍇 Endless mode: Go wild with unlimited Slot Machines and overpowered upgrades!

🍉 Several new game mechanics + graphics update

🍋‍🟩 Doubled game time!

🍓 Several bug fixes and QoL improvements!


📱 Now on Google Play! 📱
Fruit Stand Fortune was created for mobile from the start! Pachinko mechanics work really well on tall, narrow screens and it was a challenge to port over to desktop. That is why we consider the Fruit Stand Fortune app the definitive way to play the game. 

If you've enjoyed the game, please consider supporting us by grabbing it on the Google Play Store! ❤️


🍒Credits🍋 
I had a lot of help getting this update out! I want to thank Amelia and Rehpicom1 for Simplified Chinese translation and translation testing help! Thank you Bobby for always being there for me and willing to listen to me yap about this game constantly! ❤️ Also thank you Patrick and Nathan for mobile play testing, moral support, and the constructive feedback! And thank you for playing! I am truly grateful for everyone who played and the community has been so positive to me, I love my fruit fans, thank you all!

notes.title: Simplified Chinese Translation 🍒🍋
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308790/4c0c2891475b07cfde6cf66ea29a6f73be3d4809.png
Hi everyone! I'm excited to announce that Fruit Stand Fortune now supports Simplified Chinese! A big thank you to Amelia for reaching out and helping me translate the game! It was a fun process and I am happy that Fruit Stand Fortune (or 水果转转乐) will reach a new audience!

Changes
- New settings button to change between English/Simplified Chinese. By default it should grab this from the steam client
- The title screen for Simplified Chinese says 水果转转乐 which translates in English to "Fruit Spinning Fun"
- BUG: Fix horse description so it reflects the correct number of needed customers
- BUG: Fix Cherry Fan not counting as a fan (sorry Jerry)
- Misc. font improvements

Thanks for playing everyone! More changes to come soon!🍒🍋

notes.title: Bug Fix 1.7
notes.content:
Features
- Added a custom cursor! This should make it easier to see then the default cursor

Bug Fixes
- Fixed bug where the Menu Button would be hidden in landscape
- Fixed certain cases where Fruit Gun purchase wouldn't remove money

Thank you everyone for reporting bugs and playing! I am really happy with how many different people all around the world played my silly little game! Have a good day! 🍒🍋

notes.title: Bug Fix 1.5
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for the bug feedback! 🍒🍋

Fruit
- BUG: Fruit purchase button still takes your money even if you already unlocked fruit. 

Achievements
- Timer that checks if achievements are unlocked now runs quicker
- BUG: Achievements can now be unlocked even if menu is open
- BUG: "Unlock All Customers" achievement can now be unlocked before "Unlock All Fruit"

Misc
- Added version number to Settings menu, so its easier to see which version you are running
